naming.figmaVariable: token name with '.' replaced by '/' (surface.page -> surface/page)
naming.web: var(--<token name with '.' replaced by '-'>) (surface.page -> var(--surface-page))
naming.android: camelCase of the token name (surface.page -> surfacePage)

Foundations.note: Overview drawn from the variables and styles, Light and Dark side by side. Nothing on it is typed by hand.

Components.note: One section per component. Overview frame shows the same instances in Light and Dark.

Screens.note: Light row on top, dark row below (clones with the Color collection set to Dark). Built only from component instances.

Button.axes: Variant (primary, quiet) x State (default, focus, disabled, loading)

Link.axes: Tone (accent, strong, subtle) x Size (body, sm) x State (default, focus); strong exists only at body size

TextField.axes: Type (text, password) x State (empty, filled, focus, error, disabled)

Select.axes: State (empty, filled, focus, open, error, disabled)

Checkbox.axes: Checked (false, true) x State (default, focus, error, disabled)

Radio.axes: Selected (false, true) x State (default, focus, disabled)

Switch.axes: Checked (false, true) x State (default, focus, disabled)

figmaNotes: Opacity variables use a 0-100 scale in Figma: opacity.disabled is 55 there and 0.55 in tokens.json and code.
A spread shadow (shadow.focus, shadow.danger-halo) only renders on a frame that clips its content, and it is cut off by any clipping parent. Focused frames clip, their parents do not.
Frames with no fill cast no shadow, so focus variants of quiet Button, IconButton and Link use a surface.page fill, which looks the same as no fill on the page.
Icons: vectors are bound to text.primary in the main component and overridden per instance with the colour token of their context.
